svg.title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Brokerage Desk
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-first-thirty-days; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Brokerage Desk; subtitle: Build scope, systems, lender fit, and pipeline discipline before forecasting fees.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Four milestones cover Days 1–30 inclusively. Numeric values are milestone end days. This sprint prepares operations; the canonical first-deal expectation remains 3–9 months. Any unresolved licensing requirement prevents affected live activity.; caption: Finish the month with a functioning lender matrix, tested application checklist, renewal fields, and a funded runway plan rather than an invented first-month closing target.; stages: label: Define the permitted desk; value: Days 1–7 | Scope and economics; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose two initial financing products and launch jurisdictions. Document licensing and fee requirements, assign the four core seats, and reconcile the $120,000, $560,000, and $1,000,000 retained-fee scenarios to their respective margins and team sizes.; label: Build the evidence system; value: Days 8–14 | Checklists and security; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Configure HubSpot stages, Airtable lender fields, document permissions, MFA, and missing-file reminders. Test three synthetic borrower files covering equipment, receivables, and bridge use cases; resolve access and arithmetic defects before loading live records.; label: Validate lender fit; value: Days 15–21 | Coverage and terms; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Research eight candidate lenders and obtain documented appetite confirmation from at least four. Record ticket size, geography, collateral, exclusions, fee terms, clawbacks, and contacts. Keep unconfirmed lenders outside automated matching recommendations.; label: Run the controlled pipeline; value: Days 22–30 | Outreach and operating review; numeric value: 30.0; detail: After required permissions are in place, conduct ten qualified referral conversations and request three complete borrower packages. Treat these as activity targets, not promised conversions. Review cash runway, concentration, file defects, and next-month ownership.

text.title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Brokerage Desk
text.tspan: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Brokerage Desk

circle.title: label: Define the permitted desk; value: Days 1–7 | Scope and economics; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose two initial financing products and launch jurisdictions. Document licensing and fee requirements, assign the four core seats, and reconcile the $120,000, $560,000, and $1,000,000 retained-fee scenarios to their respective margins and team sizes.

label: Build the evidence system; value: Days 8–14 | Checklists and security; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Configure HubSpot stages, Airtable lender fields, document permissions, MFA, and missing-file reminders. Test three synthetic borrower files covering equipment, receivables, and bridge use cases; resolve access and arithmetic defects before loading live records.

label: Validate lender fit; value: Days 15–21 | Coverage and terms; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Research eight candidate lenders and obtain documented appetite confirmation from at least four. Record ticket size, geography, collateral, exclusions, fee terms, clawbacks, and contacts. Keep unconfirmed lenders outside automated matching recommendations.

label: Run the controlled pipeline; value: Days 22–30 | Outreach and operating review; numeric value: 30.0; detail: After required permissions are in place, conduct ten qualified referral conversations and request three complete borrower packages. Treat these as activity targets, not promised conversions. Review cash runway, concentration, file defects, and next-month ownership.

text.title: Assumptions: Four milestones cover Days 1–30 inclusively. Numeric values are milestone end days. This sprint prepares operations; the canonical first-deal expectation remains 3–9 months. Any unresolved licensing requirement prevents affected live activity.
